جَأْرٌ , applied to herbage, (Az, A, K,) (tropical:) Fresh, juicy, or sappy: (K, * TA:) or tall, and fullgrown: (Az, TA:) and abundant. (A, K.) ―
-b2- غَيْثٌ جَأْرٌ, (K,) and ↓ جُؤَرٌ , (As, S, A, K,) and, accord. to As, ↓ جُؤَارٌ , (TA voce جَوَرٌّ,) as also جِوَرٌّ, (K,) (tropical:) A copious rain; (As, S, A, K;) that makes the plants, or herbage, to grow tall: (A:) or the second, a rain that makes a sound, or noise. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
